domain: fixed-gauge finite periodic Bianchi-I reference torus; common normal observer, physical direction and screen labels
opacity: nu=n_e_star*sigma_T*c; proper electron density; beta=v_e/c; rates may be multiplied by T_star
carrier: P8 real S+A encoding of Hermitian S+iA; average physical carrier, retain signed fluctuations
decomposition: mean(nu L_beta J)=nubar L_ref Jbar+L_ref mean(dnu xi)+mean(nu(L_beta-L_ref))Jbar+mean(nu(L_beta-L_ref)xi)
reference: mean current rest velocity by default; nu_current is not mean(nu); reference choice changes terms, not their sum
moving_measure: Pdot J is separate from collisions; P xidot=-Pdot xi
force: local elasticity F0=beta.F; mean-frame defect equals mean((beta-beta_current).Fspatial), not generally a covariance about arithmetic mean beta
spatial_memory: two equal-volume reaction-only cells; exact known-source Schur/Duhamel identity, not an independent spatial Volterra solver
positivity: checked on recorded total/mean fixtures only; no clipping of fluctuations
full_contract: Immutable ZIP OPERATOR_CONTRACT.json; this published summary is not its byte identity
